items.exampleEn: I use the internet every day.
My mother works at a hospital.
We study in a group of four.
My uncle sells shoes. His business is very good.
items.exampleZh: 我叔叔賣鞋子，他的生意很好。

items.exampleEn: I stay at home on Sunday.
She has an important role in the team.
items.exampleZh: 她在團隊裡扮演重要的角色。

items.exampleEn: Tom is the leader of our group.
items.exampleZh: Tom 是我們這一組的組長。

items.sentenceEn: Please wait for me after work.

items.audioEn: I usually stay at work until seven. Then I go home.
items.audioZh: 我通常在公司待到七點，然後回家。
items.questionZh: 說話者通常在公司待到幾點？

items.sentenceEn: Our group has a new leader.
items.sentenceZh: 我們這一組有新組長了。

items.sentenceEn: I read the news on the internet.

items.stemEn: Can you ____ here for a minute?
items.stemZh: 你可以在這裡等一下嗎？

items.stemEn: Mrs. Chen is the ____ of our team.
items.stemZh: 陳太太是我們團隊的領導者。

items.passageEn: Amy works for a small internet business. She is the leader of a group of five people. Every morning, the group has a short meeting. Each person talks about their role for the day. Amy often stays late at work, but she loves her job.
items.passageZh: Amy 在一家小型網路公司上班。她帶領一個五人小組。每天早上，小組會開一個簡短的會議，每個人說說自己當天負責的工作。Amy 常常在公司待到很晚，但她很喜歡她的工作。

questions.questionZh: Amy 帶領幾個人的小組？
Amy 下班的時間通常怎樣？

referenceEn: I will wait for you at home.
I am waiting for you at home.
rubricZh: 「等某人」用 wait for（例如 wait for you）
「在家」可寫 at home、be home 等
時態合理即可（例如 will wait、am waiting、wait）

items.promptZh: 今晚我們住在一家小旅館。
referenceEn: We are staying at a small hotel tonight.
We will stay at a small hotel tonight.
rubricZh: stay 後面接地點（例如 stay at a small hotel、stay in a small hotel）
今晚的事可寫，例如 are staying、will stay 等
